//: dev-notests -- the dev world with the test machinery left out. Was the `--notests` flag
A subtraction, so it is spelled as one: everything EXCEPT the harness part. That single
exclusion is what drops the js/tests link, BUILDFLAG_LOAD_TESTS, the two tests-repo build
gates, FileSaver/JSZip, the harness pointer icons and the macro engine (src/macros, which the
harness part owns: only the harness ever starts a macro, so without it the engine is inert) --
The entries are a subtraction for the same reason: worldWithSystemTestHarness.html exists to run
the harness, so without the part it would boot a world with nothing to run, and buildProfile.py
refuses that pairing. index.html and index-sw.html are what this tree is for.
Nothing in the workspace builds this automatically -- it is a hand-typed check that the product
still stands up with the test machinery gone, short of a full production build.
